how_to_apply: Fill in the Application Form online at the AMU Careers Portal, following the advertisement and the User Manual on the portal.
Fill a separate form for each post listed under a different serial number.
After submitting, print the PDF of the form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date on the top-left side of the cover.
Send the complete form by post to: Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.
Documents to enclose, with originals of all of them brought for verification at the interview:
All marksheets, certificates and degrees from class Xth to postgraduation, including the High School Certificate from a recognized board
Valid registration of graduation and post graduation from NMC
No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if employed, and relieving orders of all previous employers
Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc., as the case may be
Applicants from a Madrasa background may use a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation if it was obtained from Madaris/Institutions recognized by the University, wherever applicable.

Applications received late, sent on plain paper, left incomplete or missing the required documents shall be summarily rejected. No document or information can be added after the last date of submission.

content_sections.heading: AMU Senior Resident Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational qualification (all three departments): As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU. Nationality: Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form. Any relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum, so meeting them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Posts earmarked for PwD candidates are open only to persons with a relevant disability of at least 40%. They must upload a Disability Certificate issued by the Competent Authority on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I). The University's Medical Board examines the claim for selected applicants before the appointment letter is issued. The applicable categories are: Blindness and low vision (VH) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness Multiple disabilities from amongst the above categories, including deaf-blindness See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Local Selection Committee of eligible candidates, held on 25 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Candidates report half an hour before their scheduled time. The University may limit the number of applicants called for interview to a reasonable number, and may set up a committee to scrutinize and short-list applications. It will not correspond with applicants who are not short-listed. If a mistake in scrutiny or selection is found at any stage, even after an interview or appointment letter is issued, the University may modify, withdraw or cancel the selection process.

Phil/Ph.D. degree, wherever applicable Applicants from a Madrasa background may use a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation if it was obtained from Madaris/Institutions recognized by the University, wherever applicable. Applications received late, sent on plain paper, left incomplete or missing the required documents shall be summarily rejected. No document or information can be added after the last date of submission.

faq.question: Q1. Is submitting the online form enough?
faq.answer: No. The printed, signed form with self-attested documents must also be sent by post, and hard copies will not be received after 04:00 p.m. on 16 November 2026. The University will not be responsible for postal delay.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply to more than one department?
faq.answer: Yes, but each post under a different serial number needs its own form, and the Rs. 500/- fee applies to each form.

faq.question: Q3. Will I receive an interview letter?
faq.answer: Point 3 on page 1 says no separate notice or interview letter will be issued for the Local Selection Committee. Instruction 13 on page 3 says call letters will be sent only to short-listed applicants. Because the two differ, keep 25 November 2026 free and check the Careers Portal regularly for updates.

faq.question: Q4. Can OCI Cardholders apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The advertisement covers OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.

faq.question: Q5. I am currently employed. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: You need a No Objection Certificate from your present employer, along with relieving orders from all previous employers.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I do not bring my original documents?
faq.answer: A candidate who does not bring the originals for verification will not be allowed to appear before the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where can PwD candidates get the disability certificate proforma?
faq.answer: Appendix-I is available on the AMU website, the Registrar website and the Careers Portal, all linked above.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact for help with the form?
faq.answer: The Help Desk is available on all working days during office hours at +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178). The User Manual on the Careers Portal also gives guidance.
